source.head: feature/stale-cache
source.note: Illustrative metadata; no Git access is performed.

steps.title: Misses still refresh immediately
steps.description: The missing-entry path keeps its existing behavior. Only an already cached stale entry takes the new path.

annotations.text: No stale value exists to return.

steps.title: Schedule refresh without blocking
steps.description: Stale entries schedule work for a later event-loop turn. Production refresh functions should use asynchronous I/O.

annotations.text: Scheduling separates refresh from the current caller.

steps.title: Return the cached value
steps.description: The caller receives the cached value immediately. Completion of the refresh affects a subsequent request.
